title: Resonances of a pipe closed at one end
caption: A closed end must be a displacement node and an open end an antinode, so only odd quarter-wavelengths fit: λ = 4L/n with n = 1, 3, 5. For L = 0.3 m, the lowest two resonances are 286 Hz and 858 Hz.
alt: Displacement envelopes in a pipe closed at the left: a quarter wavelength for the first harmonic and three quarters for the third.
description: Fundamental: L = λ/4, λ = 1.2 m, f = 343 / 1.2 = 285.8 Hz.
Next: L = 3λ/4, λ = 0.4 m, f = 857.5 Hz, three times the fundamental.
Even harmonics cannot fit: they would need an antinode at the closed end.
